result.summary: Found 3 issues: content is cut off at the right edge of horizontal scroll sections and category filter row, and a promotional badge shows an unclear/likely erroneous value.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal card list is cut off abruptly at the right edge, showing a partial restaurant card (Trattoria Piccol...) with truncated text and image, indicating the scroll area is clipped by the viewport without a clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient edge or partial card preview intentionally sized to hint at scrollability, and ensure text doesn't get awkwardly truncated mid-word.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is cut off on the right side with an additional partially visible pill, suggesting more categories exist off-screen without a clear scroll indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade gradient at the edge of the scrollable filter row to indicate more content is available.

issues.description: The pizza promotional card at the bottom shows a '-100%' discount badge, which is unusual and could look like an error (implying free food, likely unintended or a placeholder value).
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount value is correct; if intentional (e.g., free item promo), consider clarifying the label such as 'Free' instead of '-100%' for clarity.
